verifies.G074-C6: with the Blaze-Persistence Spring Data integration declared in the build and an entity view of the entity in the project (created by a preAction), the standard repository action Create Spring Data repository with options first asks Repository for (the entity or the entity view) and, when the view is chosen, creates a repository extending EntityViewRepository<WidgetView, Long>. Without Blaze or without a view the prompt is absent (unit tests). The original shows the view choice inside one window with the other repository options; here it is a leading choice and the repository parent options are not shown for views.
